notes.title: Spring Update! 02/03/2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31662152/bb753deb40664247464528e55282c9b9d24b12ab.png[/img]

Hi there!
Congrats on surviving thru this cold winter.
We now have Bots (Easy, Medium and Hard), you can access Duel
thru Main Menu.
Also, it's springtime in the Tavern!
We've also worked on optimization.

Hope to see you at the Tavern!

notes.title: Micro Update 14/11/2018
notes.content:
Update is now arriving to your Steam

- Orc Attack temporarily removed (will be reworked completely)

notes.title: Update 02/10/2018
notes.content:
[h1]What's new: 	[/h1]
- DRAGONS! 4 types of them actually! 
- Invisible Cloak! Hide yourself from everyone!
- Balance. Not so exciting, though really useful.
- Fall location ("Fallen leaves, fallen leaves, fallen leaves on the ground" (c) Billy Talent)
- Overall fixes, problem with Michel Jackson's style spawning angle fixed
Soon I will update you on our next moves.

notes.title: Update 14/09/2018
notes.content:
Hi! Until now finding your friend's server was a bit complicated. From now on we have new faster online system!
- All sessions are visible momentarily!
- Creation tool: as a host you can now comfortably create sessions for your friends and guests without headset. 
Just run the game, press 1 on your keyboard, navigate thru menu to Multiplay tab, host a server and hide your pawn's body by pressing P!
Cinematic camera system will allow you to create great shots of your friends Duels. Stream your personal Tavern on Twitch!

Don't forget to join our friendly community on Discord! 
www.gnamics.com

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31662152/4be832ef2c07c456922be762d28b3c0cf13fd298.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 07/09/2018
notes.content:
- New card types (Beams and Totem) 
- Inventory (Prototipe)
- Updated graphics, some interactivity with surroundings
- Minor bug and balance fixes
- Major Boss (Dungeon) fixes
- Full Oculus Rift and Touch support
- Cinematic camera (press P on keyboard if you are a Host) - allows non-VR players to surf around maps in cinematic way. Will be usefull for streaming and recording gameplay videos

notes.title: Update 19.06.2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31662152/212b3e90e62448784461b8b4ee662be91c7ae9a0.jpg[/img]

We are happy to present you newest Update.

Now you can try our Dungeon, introduction in what other Dungeons will be like.

Next stops: 

Generating them as you go
Mirrored Dungeons (4v4; PvPvE)
More melee weapons (Bows too)
High-grade tutorial level
Keep tracking those Beta keys in our Twitter! 

There is still no Matchmaking, so you need friends to play with. Join our Discord!

All links you can find here: www.gnamics.com

Feel free to share your opinion!

notes.title: Update 07.04.2018
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW

Sword is now availible in Duels. It is placed between HP and MP bottles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31662152/750ec920b1ed6e1ba7dac656c132b330eb8cb667.png[/img]

Grab it with trigger, when finished - release it and sword will place itself back to the same slot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31662152/6ca325e294a89e49720c0a272167b489bf604d6d.png[/img]

PARAORC-WARRIOR
Bottom card on your right hand. Attaking nearby enemies with sword.
You cast up to 3 of them in one time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31662152/801c3994a27d2a768a4a0aa5473e80ff60f606f9.png[/img]

PARAORC-COOK
As an enemy - not very strong, but a great cook if you don't mind some boogers.

SINGLE PLAYER MINI GAME

Orcs Attack
While offline open Menu, there choose this game mode to test your skill against waves of Paraorcs.

This is not the final edition, we are working on new types of enemies.

To go back to the Tavern you have to... die.

MINOR CHANGES

Graphics settings under "settings" buttons in menu or press num1, num2 or num3.
Voice chat is now activated (temporarily without function to mute).
Better teleportation and synchronisation.

WISH TO JOIN?
Track Beta Access giveaways at our Twitter (@gnamics)
